rounding_convention: decimal.Decimal throughout; each period's depreciation quantized to whole dollars with ROUND_HALF_UP as computed (per period). No PVs in this item. Both schedules closed exactly: press AD ties to 45 months x $1,125 = $50,625 (BV $39,375 at 9/30/20X4); mill AD ties to 33 months x $1,000 = $33,000 (BV $30,000 at 6/30/20X7). Monthly rates are exact, so no rounding plug was required (asserted in code). Exchange has commercial substance -> full loss recognized; mill cost = FV of press given up + cash paid, since the press's FV is the more clearly determinable measure.
